description: Grondwateronttrekkingen voor industrie en drinkwater is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices.provinciegroningen.nl. This file contains all abstraction wells of all groundwater abstractions in the province of Groningen that are subject to a permit for drinking water and industrial purposes. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Groundwater abstractions for industry and drinking water" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2022-12-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
